# Items reference manual

Reference manual for: objects, nodes, markers, loads and sensors

This chapter includes the reference manual for all objects (bodies/constraints), nodes, markers, loads and sensors (**= items**).
For description of types (e.g., the meaning of `Vector3D` or `NumpyMatrix`), see {ref}`sec-typesdescriptions`.
